intended_purpose: A consumer lifestyle product intended to help general users track daily water intake and receive hydration reminders via a companion smartphone app. Not intended to diagnose, treat, monitor, or prevent any disease or medical condition.
device_description: Insulated smart water bottle with an internal fluid-level sensor and Bluetooth connectivity, marketed with wellness-oriented language including 'hydration monitoring sensor,' 'clinically inspired design,' and 'patient-grade tracking accuracy' for consumer appeal, despite having no diagnostic, therapeutic, or medical function.
clinical_data_summary: Internal consumer research (n=150 general population volunteers, informal survey) found users self-reported drinking more water while using the product; no clinical trial, medical claim, or regulatory evidence pathway is applicable since this is a general consumer wellness product, not a medical device.
risk_summary: General consumer product safety review per applicable consumer product regulations (not ISO 14971, as this is not a medical device); risks assessed are limited to battery safety and choking-hazard-sized parts.

clinical_trial_data.trial_name: Informal consumer survey, n=150 (not a clinical trial)
